confidence_notes: Beer, coffee and inexpensive-meal anchors come from one search of crowd-sourced cost-of-living aggregates (MyLifeElsewhere, Nomad Watch, Freenance). I ran no further searches, so the mid-range meal, cocktail and wine figures are estimates. Cocktail and wine are set from the local relationship to beer (cocktail about 2.3x beer, wine glass about 1.3x beer). Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not live listings, and are the least certain. The RBA rate was the latest found in search, as at 18 Nov 2026. It is a later date than the July 2026 pricing window.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other mid-sized Romanian university and tourism cities such as Sibiu and Brasov. Cluj-Napoca is priced about 20% above the Romanian average. It is cheaper than Western European cities of similar size.
